worlds.demons: an infernal wasteland: cracked black basalt and cooling lava fissures, jagged obsidian shards, the ruined ribs of a bone-and-iron arch lying collapsed flat on the ground, ash drifting slowly, thin black smoke. Everything is deep charcoal and volcanic near-black. Faint MAGENTA accents only: a violet-magenta glow deep inside the fissures and a magenta cast in the drifting smoke.
worlds.mummies: a moonlit desert necropolis: low wind-rippled dunes and half-buried sandstone blocks, the stepped square summit of a weathered step-pyramid, the toppled fragments of a colossal broken statue lying in the sand, wind-blown sand hazing the air. Everything is deep umber-black and cold grey-brown. Faint AMBER-GOLD accents only: a dull gold glimmer on one carved stone lintel and a warm amber haze low over the sand.
worlds.nagas: a drowned military citadel on the deep sea floor: toppled basalt columns lying on the silt, the ribbed hull of a sunken war-galley, the harsh angular foundations of fortress walls, a broken sea-god statue lying face-down, silt drifting in slow currents, the water almost black. Everything is deep teal-black and slate. Faint CYAN accents only: a cold cyan glow leaking from arrow-slits in the sunken wall tops and a thin cyan shimmer on the drifting silt.
worlds.orcs: a badlands war-camp at dusk: cracked red-brown hardpan and scattered bones, the pointed stake-tips of a crude timber palisade, round hide-tent roofs, the plank platform of a rough watchtower, the broken rim of a mesa cliff, dust hanging low. Everything is deep rust-black and dull brown. Faint BURNT-ORANGE accents only: two or three low banked cook-fires glowing dully behind the palisade and a thin orange glow in the dust.
worlds.vampires: a mountain valley at night: black jagged pine forest seen as dense dark treetops, steep bare crag ledges of grey rock, a thin cold mist lying in the hollows, the slate roofs of a few distant stone houses. Everything is deep blue-black and charcoal. Faint CRIMSON accents only: a dull red glow in a handful of small roof-windows and a cold crimson tint along the edge of the mist.
worlds.zombies: a rotting swamp of ruined cottages: black still water and mats of dead reeds, the broken shingle roofs of collapsed timber cottages, flat gravestone slabs half-sunk in mud, the bare branching silhouettes of dead trees, a low clinging fog lying over the water. Everything is deep bog-green-black and wet grey. Faint SICKLY GREEN accents only: a dull swamp-glow rising off the water in two or three patches and a faint green phosphorescence on the rotten timber.

seams.demons|mummies: the black basalt cools and crumbles into ash-dusted dark sand, with a few glassy, heat-fused patches where the two grounds meet.
seams.demons|nagas: the black basalt slopes down into shallow black water; where the last fissures meet the sea a faint low steam haze hangs and the rock cools into dark rounded pillow-stone.
seams.demons|orcs: the basalt fissures fade out and the ground turns into scorched, cracked red-brown hardpan, with ash settling over the dust.
seams.demons|vampires: the basalt gives way to burnt black pine stumps and then to living dark treetops; drifting ash mixes into the cold mist.
seams.demons|zombies: the cooling basalt meets black swamp water and steams faintly; scorched rock gives way to wet mud and dead reeds.
seams.mummies|nagas: the sand slopes down into a dark drowned shoreline; half-buried sandstone blocks slip under black still water and settle into silt.
seams.mummies|orcs: the dunes flatten out into cracked red-brown hardpan; sand drifts in thin tongues across the dry clay and scattered bones.
seams.mummies|vampires: the dunes give way to rocky scree and then to the first black pine treetops; cold mist lies low over the last of the sand.
seams.mummies|zombies: the dry sand darkens into wet mud and then into black swamp water; dead reeds take root in the damp sand.
seams.nagas|orcs: the sea floor shelves up into a dark muddy tidal flat that dries out into cracked red-brown hardpan.
seams.nagas|vampires: the sea floor rises into the wet rock of a black mountain-lake shore; dark pine treetops crowd the waterline under the mist.
seams.nagas|zombies: the deep sea floor shallows into black brackish swamp water; drowned reeds and drifting silt mix together.
seams.orcs|vampires: the hardpan grows rocky and rises into bare crag ledges and then the first dark pine treetops; the dust thins into cold mist.
seams.orcs|zombies: the cracked hardpan softens into wet mud and stagnant black pools; the hanging dust gives way to low fog.
seams.vampires|zombies: the pine forest drops into a sodden hollow where the trees die and the ground turns to black swamp water; the mist and the swamp fog merge into one.
